owner_instruction: The owner, 2026-09-28, in reply to the six proposals on the launch page (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/0a86a746-7375-4518-a988-eb6b8e53b25e): "הכל מאושר. רק לילדים תעשה מחיר 89 לגופיה". Proposal 3.
what: Burnley, West Ham and Wolves play the 2026-27 Championship and Girona the Segunda División, so their 15 shirts left the Premier League and LaLiga pages, filters and menus for ליגות נוספות. The team pages themselves did not change.

changes.metafield: sportwear.league_handle = championship / segunda-division (the league filter); sportwear.leagues was empty on all 15
changes.other_leagues_rule: other-leagues (gid://shopify/Collection/512860160304) also takes TAG league:championship and TAG league:segunda-division (11 conditions, any)
changes.filter_names: shop metafield sportwear.filter_names rewritten from taxonomy.json: the two leagues added, nothing else changed (read back and compared byte for byte)
changes.menu: main-menu: ווסטהאם, וולברהמפטון and ברנלי left פרמייר ליג, ג׳ירונה left לה ליגה; the four were appended to ליגות נוספות (after the existing 16). menuUpdate sent the full tree; all 200 items kept their ids, titles, links and translations (read back and compared)
changes.catalog_files: catalog/taxonomy.json and catalog/classification.json (the two leagues, the four teams), the 15 product files in catalog/published/
changes.order: other-leagues re-sorted by scripts/catalog/collection-order.py (67 moves); check: all 143 collections in order

checked: Storefront: premier-league 80 products and la-liga 62, none of the four clubs; other-leagues 89 with all 15. SportWear (next): the league filter on other-leagues lists צ׳מפיונשיפ (12) and הליגה הספרדית השנייה (3), in English and Arabic too. Product and team pages need no change: a football league without a page of its own falls back to other-leagues (banner, league row, breadcrumb shows כדורגל).
